headline._: A quiet day. The journalist's passes found nothing new; the rest of the newsroom is stopped. Still no organisation confirms a compromise.
headline.exec: Nothing new for you. Still no organisation says it was hit; the fix is out.
headline.general: Nothing new for you. If someone runs your website, ask them if it is updated.
headline.security: Nothing moved the measures. Dream Research's report stays reported, not confirmed; nothing is captured because the researcher is stopped.
headline.engineer: Nothing new to install. Confirm the fixed version is what is running.
headline.journalist: Five passes, nothing new; the compromise stamps stay at 09:42 UTC on 30 October.
headline.researcher: No capture on the day: the researcher and curator are stopped.
